Game Overview

Skulls and Bombs puts players into a casual experience centered on set sail in Skulls And Bombs, where quick reflexes are your compass to treasure. Tap swiftly to score, but avoid the treacherous skulls and bombs. With increasing speed, every moment teeters between riches and ruin.
